svg.aria-label: Twenty-eight test origins each predict seven days. Ridge forecasts, observations, and fixed calibrated intervals appear above the origin-by-horizon error map; the right panel compares MAE by horizon for six methods. Weekly origin spacing links each horizon to a fixed weekly phase.
